## Checklist

### For new tool additions:
- [ ] Tool is actively maintained (commits within the last 12 months)
- [ ] Tool is directly relevant to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- [ ] Description is accurate, concise, and non-promotional
- [ ] All links are working and point to official resources
- [ ] Entry is placed in the correct category
- [ ] Entry follows the existing table format
- [ ] Entry is in alphabetical order within its category
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing entry

### For all changes:
- [ ] I have checked for spelling and grammar errors
- [ ] I have verified all links are accessible
- [ ] The change renders correctly in Markdown preview
